result:
Confirmed: owner(4) > admin(3) > member(2) > viewer(1).

I checked the three permission gates named in the prompt against `src/lib/permissions.ts`'s `ROLE_MATRIX` (the single authorization source of truth):

- `comment:create` → actual minimum is `member` (rank 2). `docs/requirements/comments-and-mentions.md` states *"comment:create carries a viewer minimum in ROLE_MATRIX"* — claiming viewers (rank 1) can comment, which the code does not allow.
- `project:archive` → actual minimum is `admin` (rank 3). `docs/requirements/projects.md` (REQ-045) states *"project:archive is gated at owner in ROLE_MATRIX — the same minimum as project:delete"* — claiming only owners (rank 4) can archive, but the code lets admins do it too, i.e. it doesn't enforce the doc's stated floor of ownership-only restriction on who's excluded... more precisely, the doc's claim about the actual gate value is simply wrong relative to the code.
- `org:manage_flags` (feature-flag settings screen, `flags/page.tsx`) → actual minimum is `admin` (rank 3). `docs/ui/screen-settings-billing-flags-webhooks.md` (SCR-022) states *"Permission required: org:manage_flags (member and above) — 404 otherwise"* — claiming members (rank 2) can open the screen, but the code 404s them since `admin` is required.

Each doc asserts a role floor that the actual `ROLE_MATRIX` value in `src/lib/permissions.ts` contradicts.

ANSWER: docs/requirements/comments-and-mentions.md, docs/requirements/projects.md, docs/ui/screen-settings-billing-flags-webhooks.md
